subject: Demo timing — bridging March DST stagger for FinLedger
messages:
From: Kate Morris <kate.morris@finledger.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 13:20:00 +0000
Subject: Demo — coordination next week around DST

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick reply on the pilot interest. We're excited to see Redwood in action. A couple of stakeholders in EU and APAC have requested a single session so they can attend together, but I realized the week we're targeting overlaps the US daylight savings start and the EU change happens the following week. Can you advise whether you can run one session that keeps latency-sensitive folks (APAC) comfortable while not forcing our EU team to join at midnight?

Rough availability from our side (Mar 11–15):
- EU: 09:00–12:00 CET (preferred)
- US: 10:00–18:00 ET (flexible)
- APAC: 08:00–11:00 SGT (morning only)

If a single time isn't feasible, happy to take two shorter sessions. Also looping scheduling@finledger.com to coordinate invites.

Best,
Kate Morris
Director, Platform Ops
FinLedger

--
FinLedger Scheduling: scheduling@finledger.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Kate Morris <kate.morris@finledger.com>, FinLedger Scheduling <scheduling@finledger.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Demo — coordination next week around DST

Hi Kate — thanks for the details and the availability windows. Short answer: yes, we can do a single session but need to be intentional about the exact slot to avoid a painful time for EU or APAC.

A couple quick notes from operations:
- US moves one week earlier this year (Mar 14) and EU follows Mar 29 — that creates a one-week stagger where the offsets are different from usual.
- For tri-region sessions during that stagger, we typically pick either: (A) an APAC-friendly morning that pushes EU late evening, or (B) a mid-US afternoon that lands early morning for APAC and late morning for EU.

Proposed plan: run a single 60-minute demo at 15:00 ET on Thu Mar 11 / 20:00 CET / Fri 04:00 SGT — option A; or 13:00 ET on Fri Mar 12 / 18:00 CET / Sat 02:00 SGT — option B. Option B is slightly worse for APAC but keeps EU in-office hours.

Marcus / Soojin — can you review and flag capacity for a hands-on run with role-based lanes (platform + security + integration)? I'll attach a timezone grid and a quick mutual action plan with proposed owners.

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: timezone-grid.png (image stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kate Morris <kate.morris@finledger.com>, FinLedger Scheduling <scheduling@finledger.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo — coordination next week around DST

Thanks Tessa — quick operational check and recommendation:

- We prefer option A if FinLedger can accept APAC being at 04:00 SGT for a single session; it gives us the least context switching and keeps our EU participants awake but not in the middle of the night.
- If APAC attendance is required during local business hours, we should run two 35-minute focused sessions (one for APAC first, one for EU/US), and record both.

I've attached a concise mutual-action-plan (MAP) with suggested owners and a clean decision line so Kate can pick a path quickly. Also, note that in the DST-stagger week the UTC offsets are:
  - US (ET) before 14 Mar: UTC-5; after 14 Mar: UTC-4
  - EU (CET) before 29 Mar: UTC+1
  - SG (SGT) const: UTC+8

Suggested final slot if going single session (less painful overall): Thu, Mar 11, 15:00 ET / 20:00 CET / Fri, Mar 12 04:00 SGT — I can staff that.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
